items.name: Supportive conversation partner
items.description: Listen and reflect with care, without religious pressure or unsupported certainty.

items.name: Wisdom guide
items.description: Explore choices, responsibility and meaning while preserving the user's own judgment.

items.name: Text researcher
items.description: Inspect original wording, context, translation choices and textual variants.

items.name: Comparative scholar
items.description: Compare attributed readings, supporting evidence, differences and counterevidence.

items.name: Critical interlocutor
items.description: Question assumptions and arguments with the same care and respect for each tradition.
